title: Spanish speaker gets a callback in Spanish
instructions: Speak only Spanish for the whole call; you speak very little English. You are Carmen Rivera. Your heat isn't working ('no tengo calefacción') in your apartment at 30-15 Steinway Street, Astoria 11103. No gas smell ('no huele a gas'). Your phone is 718 555 0184. If the assistant says the office will call you back in Spanish, say 'gracias' and end the call.
